source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Decide how to estimate the area of an irregular simple closed shape on squared or graph paper.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Squared paper is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Decide how to estimate the area of an irregular simple closed shape on' is answered as squared paper rather than simple closed shape.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Squared paper is what produces simple closed shape, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide how to estimate the area of an irregular simple.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: simple closed shape is settled by running 'Decide how to compute or reverse a rectangle's perimeter from its': A rectangle's perimeter is length + breadth + length + breadth, so it equals 2 x (length + — on the item about Decide how to estimate the area of an irregular simple.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Simple closed shape is found by multiplying the given values instead of dividing, giving 89 as the reported result — on the item about Decide how to estimate the area of an irregular simple.

intelligence.enrichment: To estimate the area of a simple closed shape, place it on squared paper with 1 unit x 1 unit squares and count area using square units; squares work well because they can fill space without gaps or overlaps.
